name: Salta
tagline: Colonial 'Salta la Linda' and gateway to rainbow canyons
summary: Salta is Argentina's most beautiful colonial city, set in a green valley of the northwest Andes. Ride the cable car up San Bernardo hill, see the Inca mummies at the MAAM museum, sing along at a folk peña, and road-trip to Cafayate's canyons and Purmamarca's seven-coloured mountain.
seasonNote: The dry season (April to October) is best; summer brings rain.
arrival: Salta airport is 20 minutes from the centre with flights from Buenos Aires.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; rent a car or join tours for the quebradas.
cashTip: Argentine prices and exchange rules change quickly; treat peso prices as rough guides. Cards work widely; foreign cards often get a favourable rate.
foodTip: Empanadas salteñas, locro, humitas and torrontés wine.

connections.note: Via the Villazón border; or tours via San Pedro de Atacama.
